newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Glynhill Int'l year net loss HK$7.93 mln.
newsitem.headline: Glynhill Int'l year net loss HK$7.93 mln.

text.p: Shr (H.K. cents) 0.87 loss vs 0.74 gain (see note)
NOTE - Glynhill International is a 54.09 pct owned subsidiary of Lai Sun Development Co Ltd. It has interests in hotels, hotel management companies and property in Canada.

The accounting policy for hotel properties whereby such assets were stated at cost and the building portion was depreciated at 2.5 percent per annum on the straight-line basis in prior years was changed during the year ended July 31, 1996.

The directors consider that the new policy, whereby such assets are now carried at historical cost and not depreciated, is consistent with industry practice and will give a fairer presentation of the results and the financial position of the group.

In restating the financial statements for 1995, the net profit for that year has been increased by HK$6.25 million and the exchange realignment credited to accumulated losses for 1995 was increased by HK$394,000. Accordingly, the carrying value of hotel properties as at August 1, 1994, was increased by HK$27.66 million and the accumulated losses have been reduced by HK$30.60 million, which includes the exchange realignment debited to accumulated losses at August 1, 1994, of HK$2.94 million.

Comparative figures have been reclassified to conform with the current year presentation. In particular, turnover generated from the flour manufacturing operation which amounted to HK$121.67 million has been excluded from the group's turnover in 1995 as directors do not consider it a principal activity of the group.
Total dividend for year is nil vs nil.
